integrity: A complete proof and direct finite-verification program accompany the claim; finite tests do not replace the asymptotic proof. Accessible literature includes the full 1994 report and 2017 run-ratio paper, but only partial accessible material from the 2017 fixed-point work. No independent review or priority certification has occurred.
scientific_limitations: For fixed integer k >= 4 as n tends to infinity; original unsentinelled cyclic Burrows-Wheeler transformation, binary alphabet, and linear output runs. Quantitative Theta order only; no exact leading constant, no growing-weight regime or bit-compression rate claim.
title: Sharp scarcity of clustered BWT outputs at every fixed sparse binary weight
